source: https://euclinicaltrials.eu/ctis-public-api (the EU CTIS public portal API: POST /search, GET /retrieve/{ctNumber})
terms: EMA legal notice (https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/about-us/legal-notice, read 2026-10-04): information and documents on EMA webpages are public and may be reproduced and distributed for non-commercial and commercial purposes provided EMA is acknowledged as the source. The API is not documented by EMA; the shapes here are recorded, not specified.

search-breast-cancer-page1.json.note: POST /search, pagination {page:1,size:2}, sort decisionDate DESC, searchCriteria {medicalCondition:"breast cancer"}. Verbatim; ten items elsewhere exist, only the first two are kept by size:2.

search-no-match.json.note: A free-text search that matches nothing: successful-empty (HTTP 200, totalRecords 0, showWarning false). Verbatim.

search-refused-body.json.note: A search body with no searchCriteria object: HTTP 200, showWarning true, totalRecords 0 and no rows -- a refusal that reads like an empty result. Verbatim.

retrieve-authorised-2026-525672-26-01.js.note: GET /retrieve/2026-525672-26-01: an authorised, not-yet-started trial with arms, endpoints, criteria and one member state. Contact e-mail and telephone values (8) were replaced by "[redacted]" before commit; nothing else was changed.

retrieve-ended-2024-513060-26-00.json.note: GET /retrieve/2024-513060-26-00: an ended trial (early termination) in three member states with notified events, sites and a results summary; its public part lists no arms. Contact e-mail and telephone values (34) were replaced by "[redacted]" before commit; nothing else was changed.

retrieve-unknown.json.note: GET /retrieve/2099-000000-00-00: an unknown CT number is HTTP 200 and an empty object. Verbatim.

search-breast-cancer-page1000.json.note: The same search at page 1000 (size 2; the search has 230 pages): HTTP 200, the real totalRecords, currentPage 1000 and no rows. A page far past that (9999) is refused with showWarning true, like a body with no criteria. Verbatim.
